prompt: [aang:subagents] Use the Agent tool with the general-purpose subagent type for each step. First start one foreground subagent (run_in_background false) with the prompt "[aang:sub-solo] Run `echo solo` with the Bash tool and report its output." and wait for it. Then, in a single message, start two foreground subagents in parallel with the prompts "[aang:sub-left] Run `echo left` with the Bash tool and report its output." and "[aang:sub-right] Run `echo right` with the Bash tool and report its output.". Finally start one background subagent (run_in_background true) with the prompt "[aang:sub-back] Run `sleep 2 && echo back` with the Bash tool and report its output." and reply with one sentence without waiting for it.
